headline: Skubal has now met four teams, Lowe has a half-dozen suitors, and every posted player is racing a Dec. 1 lockout clock.

news.note: San Diego met Skubal Wednesday, joining the Mets, Dodgers and Blue Jays. Two unnamed teams are also believed to be in.
news.title: Padres become the fourth team to sit down with Skubal

news.note: Morosi says more than a half-dozen teams are on Brandon Lowe, including the Pirates and Rays. Mooney reports the Cubs have scouted Teruaki Sato and evaluated Jarren Duran.
news.title: Hot Stove: Lowe draws strong interest; Cubs scout Sato, eye Duran

news.note: MLB's plan is a $258.2M cap and $180.2M floor from 2028. The Dodgers would be $174M over; a Dec. 2 lockout would freeze all signings and trades.
news.title: Manfred: no labor deal without a cap and floor

news.note: Two years, $55M guaranteed, with a $30M player option for 2028. Gray, 37, had a 2.72 ERA and finished fifth in AL Cy Young voting.
news.title: Twins sign Sonny Gray

news.note: Seattle gets Garcia, James McArthur and L.P. Langevin; Kansas City gets Miller, Logan Evans and Jose A. Ferrer. Dipoto says no more starters will be traded.
news.title: Royals, Mariners swap Maikel Garcia for Bryce Miller in six-player deal
